result.summary: Found 1 issue: a functionality problem with a loading spinner stuck on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section has a circular loading spinner in the center of its image that appears to be stuck, preventing the actual food image from loading properly.
issues.suggestion: Investigate why the image is not loading and either fix the image source or implement a fallback state when images fail to load.
